text_block_list.text:
Time for morning practice.
Heading out to the training track a bit early—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm the first one here today too!
Being number one in everything just feels so good~♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then, go get changed right away!
We're gonna run our hearts out!

Daiwa Scarlet arrived at school
in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Kgh...! And here I thought I'd be first...!
To think I ended up coming in second...!
choice_data_list: Second place is plenty impressive too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Kgh...! And here I thought I'd be first...!
To think I ended up coming in second...!
choice_data_list: Second place is plenty impressive too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. Morning routine, ya know?
Though you beat me to the punch today.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
See, morning is when you can focus best,
and you can run all out without worrying about prying eyes.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm aiming to be number one.
I want to be the first to arrive at school and run more than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No...! Second place is unacceptable! It means nothing if I'm not number one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't be satisfied unless I'm number one!
Aaargh, it's so frustrating, frustrating, FRUSTRATING!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose tomorrow!
I'll definitely be the first one across the line!
